# Radial & zoom blur

Blurs toward or around a center point: a zoom burst that rushes at the viewer, or a spin like a rotating camera.

<EffectDemo effect="radial-blur" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { radialBlur } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/radial-blur';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(radialBlur({ preset: 'burst' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.mode = 'zoom'`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling; parameters marked _structural_ recompile the pass that contains the effect.

## Parameters

| Parameter             | Type             | Default      | Range  | Description                                                                 |
| --------------------- | ---------------- | ------------ | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `mode` _(structural)_ | 'zoom' \| 'spin' | `'zoom'`     |        | Blur along lines through the center, or along circles around it.            |
| `center`              | [x, y]           | `[0.5, 0.5]` | 0 – 1  | Center of the blur, in UV coordinates (follows the pointer in the demo).    |
| `strength`            | number           | `0.15`       | 0 – 1  | Length of the blur: a fraction of the distance to the center, or of a turn. |
| `samples`             | integer          | `24`         | 4 – 64 | Samples per pixel; more are smoother and cost more.                         |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                                       |
| -------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `burst`  | `strength: 0.35`, `samples: 32`                |
| `subtle` | `strength: 0.06`, `samples: 12`                |
| `spin`   | `mode: 'spin'`, `strength: 0.3`, `samples: 32` |
| `warp`   | `strength: 0.6`, `samples: 48`                 |

Apply one with `radialBlur({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Blur & glow · tracked as story X5.5 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Cost:** 135.8 ms added to a 960×540 frame on CI container (SwiftShader software renderer) (2026-10-11). A software renderer: use it to compare effects, not to predict GPU times.
- **Quality tiers:** low: `samples: 10`; medium: `samples: 16`; high keeps the effect's own values. Set `quality`, or leave it `auto` for an [adaptive composer](/guide/performance).
- **Size:** 6.1 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/radial-blur`, including the shared effect runtime.
